title: X-LAB AD9 season complete-bike specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the Dura-Ace R9270 / Vision Metron 60 SL complete bike. It states 7.2 kg without pedals in size S, Dura-Ace Di2 2x12 with 52/36T and 11-34T, T47 86-24, Michelin Pro 5 700x28C tires, five-size geometry and a 100 kg maximum load.
